A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CRISP research. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison across all 19 pages of v2 and 20 pages of v3.

before.justification: v2 reports original CRISP experiments on WMDP-Bio and WMDP-Cyber in Table 1, Harry Potter results in Appendix B, and empirical SAE feature analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds feature-analysis results for additional layers in Appendix C, Tables 6–7.

M1.justification: CRISP retains the same contrastive feature selection, activation-ratio filtering, LoRA optimization, and unlearning, retention, and coherence losses. The additional layer analyses do not establish a change to the algorithm or trained model configurations.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate WMDP-Bio, WMDP-Cyber, MMLU, and the Harry Potter benchmark. Harry Potter already appears in v2 Appendix B. The added feature analyses use the existing biosecurity domain and introduce no new task or test scenario.

E2.justification: ELM, RMU, and the original model remain the comparators in the corresponding benchmark and generation comparisons. The newly mentioned CAFT appears only in related work and is not evaluated.

E3.justification: The data splits, preprocessing, model sizes, 200-configuration hyperparameter searches, selection criteria, and 100-prompt generation protocol remain unchanged. Appendix F retains the same training settings. The new tables extend the existing feature analysis without specifying a revised evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: Appendix C adds analogous target, benign, and shared feature analyses for Llama-3.1-8B layers 20 and 22 and Gemma-2-2B layers 10 and 12. Tables 6–7 examine whether the patterns previously illustrated at layers 24 and 14 extend across additional layers.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations of fluency and concept ratings across 100 prompts, with identical entries in v2 Table 8 and v3 Table 11. No new run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests are reported.

E6.justification: v3 Tables 6–7 add qualitative feature-token results for four layers, including viral and immune-related target features. All numerical benchmark results and rankings remain unchanged in Table 1 and the Harry Potter table, renumbered from Table 2 to Table 3.

T1.justification: Equations 1–12 and the selection-score formulas in Appendix F are unchanged. Neither version introduces different mathematical assumptions, derivations, theoretical guarantees, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of automatic feature selection, persistent parameter-efficient unlearning, favorable WMDP trade-offs, and semantically coherent feature separation. Additional feature examples support these existing contributions.

C2.justification: The interpretations of selectivity, benign-knowledge preservation, and feature entanglement are retained. The limitations concerning SAE dependence, generalization, residual knowledge, and adversarial extraction are unchanged. The added cross-layer observations support the existing interpretation without introducing a new mechanism or limitation.

D1.justification: The stated code location changes from tomerashuach/CRISP to technion-cs-nlp/CRISP, updating the code-access instructions. Existing hyperparameters, hardware specifications, data-processing instructions, and evaluation prompts are retained.

R1.justification: Section 2.2 adds CAFT as related SAE-guided fine-tuning work addressing unintended out-of-distribution generalization, distinguishing its purpose from knowledge unlearning. The citation is rendered as CAFT (?) without a corresponding bibliography entry; the existing reference list is unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 updates affiliations and acknowledgments, makes small wording and cross-reference edits, removes the empty C.4 heading, and adds Appendix I disclosing AI assistance. The main narrative and section organization remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: v2 Figure 2 is retypeset as v3 Table 2, with shorter generation excerpts and a revised caption. Two feature-analysis tables are added, existing feature-table captions move below their tables, and floats reflow. The trade-off and feature-distribution plots are retained with updated numbering.

improvement.justification: Tables 6–7 modestly strengthen the feature-analysis evidence by extending inspection beyond the two layers shown in v2, and the retypeset generation comparison improves readability. These gains are limited: the new feature tables omit feature IDs, and the CAFT addition has an unresolved citation. The core method and benchmark evidence remain unchanged.
